# Map the Midterms

> Map the Midterms (mapthemidterms.com) is an independent, nonpartisan information site about the November 3, 2026 U.S. midterm elections. It has race guides for selected U.S. Senate, governor and U.S. House contests, published polls with links to their sources, sample-ballot outlines for 16 states, key 2026 voting deadline dates (each cited to an official election office, state law or Vote.gov), and a results tracker. It is not an official election website and does not endorse candidates. Confirm ballots, deadlines and voting rules with your state or county election office or Vote.gov. Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mapthemidterms.com/): Overview of the 2026 midterms with links to every state, race and tool on the site.
- [2026 voting deadlines by state](https://mapthemidterms.com/voting-deadlines/): Registration, early voting and mail-ballot dates for 16 states, each linked to its official source.
- [Ballot lookup](https://mapthemidterms.com/ballot/): Sample-ballot outlines by ZIP code or state, with links to official election offices.
- [Race guides](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/): Index of the Senate, governor and House races covered, with sourced candidate details.
- [Polls](https://mapthemidterms.com/polls/): Published 2026 polls, each attributed to the pollster with a source link.
- [Results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/): Results tracker for the November 3, 2026 general election. Awaiting unofficial returns. The site does not call races or invent vote totals.

## Featured races

- [Georgia U.S. Senate 2026](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ga-senate-2026/): Jon Ossoff (D, incumbent) vs. Mike Collins (R), with sourced candidate details.
- [Michigan U.S. Senate 2026](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/mi-senate-2026/): Open seat; Abdul El-Sayed (D) vs. Mike Rogers (R), with sourced candidate details.
- [North Carolina U.S. Senate 2026](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/nc-senate-2026/): Open seat; Roy Cooper (D) vs. Michael Whatley (R), with sourced candidate details.
- [Texas U.S. Senate 2026](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/tx-senate-2026/): Ken Paxton (R) vs. James Talarico (D), with sourced candidate details.

## Statewide results pages (Minnesota, Maine, Iowa, Alaska)

Awaiting unofficial returns until November 3, 2026. Candidate names are from each state's official general-election candidate list. These pages do not call races.

- [Minnesota U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/mn-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Names from the Secretary of State candidate file. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/mn-senate-2026/).
- [Minnesota Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/mn-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor tickets from the Secretary of State candidate file. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/mn-governor-2026/).
- [Maine U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/me-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Ranked-choice voting applies to this federal general-election contest, per the Secretary of State. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/me-senate-2026/).
- [Maine Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/me-governor-2026/): The candidate guide says this general election is decided by plurality. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/me-governor-2026/).
- [Iowa U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ia-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Names from the Secretary of State general-election candidate list. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ia-senate-2026/).
- [Iowa Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ia-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor names from the Secretary of State general-election candidate list. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ia-governor-2026/).
- [Alaska U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ak-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Ranked-choice voting, per the Division of Elections. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ak-senate-2026/).
- [Alaska Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ak-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor. Ranked-choice voting, per the Division of Elections. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ak-governor-2026/).
